question: When Rajesh reached the toy shop he noted that he lost his brother Anoop in the market. He walked for 60 m to the east and then turned right and went 10 m. He then turned right again and walked for 10 m to look for his brother at the ice cream shop but his brother was not there. He then turned towards the north and walked for 10 m before he saw his brother in the street. In which direction is the toy shop from Rajesh’s present position? (All tums are 90 degree tums. only)
solution:
Given:

When Rajesh reached the toy shop he noted that he lost his brother Anoop in the market.

He walked for 60 m to the east and then turned right and went 10 m.

He then turned right again and walked for 10 m to look for his brother at the ice cream shop but his brother was not there.

He then turned towards the north and walked for 10 m before he saw his brother in the street. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d45c9cf13f6ebc08b861699eac735855b98e2d09fcf220a400ba400f02eb103.png] 

So, The toy shop is at the '**West**' from Rajesh’s present position.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
